1.consolidated_definition: Planta cuya hoja de dos colores sirve para exterminar el gusano que ataca a las bestias. Posible corrupción de membrillo. (Securidaca volubilis L.).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Plant with a two-colored leaf that serves to exterminate the worm that attacks livestock. Possible corruption of guanabana (Securidaca volubilis L.).
